extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia contributors / users attempting to create or find an article
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for users who want to create or locate a Wikipedia article (here: 'Neil Young Spotify'), including account requirements, searching for existing coverage, title/redirect considerations, and checking deletion or propagation delays.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create pages
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Users who are not logged in or not autoconfirmed cannot create pages; consider logging in or registering and meeting the autoconfirmed criteria (usually an account age and edit-count threshold) before attempting to create an article.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use article wizard or request a new article
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you cannot create an article directly (e.g., due to new user restrictions), use the article wizard to prepare a draft or follow Wikipedia's 'request a new article' process so experienced editors can review and help publish it.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search existing articles for alternative titles/spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Search for "Neil Young Spotify" in existing articles. Look for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a page, thoroughly search Wikipedia to avoid duplication: try alternative capitalizations, synonyms, common misspellings, and related phrases to ensure the topic does not already exist under a different name.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for internal links to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use 'What links here' or search to find articles that reference the topic; linked pages can indicate existing coverage or suggest appropriate placement/redirects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Choose the canonical capitalization per WP:TITLE policies; if the intended title differs only by capitalization or common variants, create or request redirects so readers find the article regardless of input form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account for recently created pages, propagation delays, and deletions
rubrics_metrics.description: Other reasons this message may be displayed: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function. If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you expect a page to exist but do not see it, wait briefly and purge if necessary; if it was deleted, consult the deletion log and relevant deletion discussion to understand and potentially address notability or policy issues before reattempting creation.
